acceptanceCriteria: An MCP bridge refusal caused by a gokernel probe timeout carries a code or reasonClass distinct from a missing repository, specified in the MCP spec with owner acceptance of the wire change.
A test injects a probe timeout via gokernel.WithProbeBound and asserts the distinct classification; one mutation restoring the old mapping fails it.
body: Confirmed by instrumentation in the V1-1421 lane (PR #928, BASE 6457b86bc, darwin go1.27.2, load 53-67): every BASE failure of the internal/mcp/bridge promisor refusal controls logged gokernel repository-probe-timeout ("Git repository probe exceeded its 10-second deadline"); normalizeFailure maps it to repository-unavailable with empty ReasonClass. Expected: a slow probe is distinguishable from a missing repository (distinct code or reasonClass). Actual: callers see repository-unavailable. Repro: BASE internal/mcp/bridge promisor tests at load ~60, -count=5 (3/10 failed). PR #928 only lifts the test bound. Changing the code is an MCP wire-contract change: owner decision. Related: V1-1038 (promisor reasonClass).
title: MCP bridge reports a gokernel repository-probe-timeout as repository-unavailable with an empty reasonClass
